 This Mfa Is Filed U/S 173(1) Of Mv Act Against The
Judgment And Award Dated 15.11.2006 Passed In Mvc
No.121/2005 On The File Of The Principal Civil
Judge(Sr.Dn), Member, Additional Mact, Ramanagaram,
Partly Allowing The Claim Petition For Compensation
And Seeking Enhancement Of Compensation.

This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice P Sree Sudha
 Oral Judgment
Learned counsel for the appellant is absent.
2. Even after listing the matter under the caption 'for dismissal', there is no representation and the cost of Rs.1,000/- imposed by this Court on 29.02.2024 has not been paid till date.
This clearly indicates that the appellant has no interest to prosecute the petition and not evinced due diligence in pursuing the same, as such, no purpose is served in continuing the same.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
